Name: Willy Sells His Catch - Immersive Fish Shop Stock
Author: Smashley41
Description:
[b][u][size=6]Willy Sells His Catch[/size][/u][/b]

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]Button's Extra Trigger Action Stuff (BETAS)[/url].

Willy sells fish in his shop that he could have caught during his in-game fishing schedule. Every day, he will sell ocean fish from his pre-work morning session. On Mondays to Fridays he may include some night fish from his previous evening's session on the pier. And on Sundays, he will sell river fish from his previous day's sessions in the forest and town rivers.

Weather affects his schedule in-game, so it will also affect his inventory. For example, if it rains on a Saturday, he won't go fishing at the river, and won't have any river fish to sell the following day. He will also sell a variable quantity of each fish per day, as every fishing session is different. Some days, he might not have a certain fish at all!

He will have some useful fish to sell - if you are looking for some fish for Community Center bundles, or want to pick up some Sardines to cook Dish o' The Sea or Sea Cucumbers to put together some Lucky Lunches, or even some rare and difficult fish like the Octopus, Super Cucumber, Dorado or Lingcod, you are in luck!

However, this mod does not free you from fishing for yourself. Willy doesn't fish at the ocean on rainy evenings, so you will still have to catch your own Eel, nor does he go to the Mountain Lake so he'll never have a Sturgeon. He doesn't venture far from home, so you can't expect any fish from uncommon locations or any Legendary Fish. If you visit him at the right time, you might get a Scorpion Carp though!

The mod also includes some configurable bonus options, turned off by default. As always, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] is highly recommended for this.



[b][size=5]**DEFAULT STOCK LIST**[/size][/b]
Unless otherwise stated, he will sell 0-3 of each item listed. Yes, this means he [i]sometimes won't[/i] have a specific fish. He only sells regular quality fish.


[b][size=3]**Ocean Stock**[/size][/b]
Every morning Willy fishes in the ocean before work, and will sell potential catches that day.
On Sun-Thurs he fishes in the evenings, and will sell potential catches the following day, including previous season's fish on the 1st of the next season.
He fishes all day during SquidFest, and will sell potential catches the following day.

[list]
[*][b]Herring[/b] - Daily, Spring and Winter, plus Summer 1 if it didn't rain on Spring 28
[*][b]Anchovy[/b] - Daily, Spring and Fall, plus Summer/Winter 1 if it didn't rain on Spring/Fall 28
[*][b]Sardine[/b] - Daily, Spring, Fall and Winter, plus Summer 1 if it didn't rain on Spring 28
[*][b]Red Snapper[/b] - Daily, Summer, Fall and Winter, on rainy days only
[*][b]Sea Cucumber[/b] - Daily, Fall and Winter
[*][b]Tilapia[/b] - Daily, Summer and Fall
[*][b]Flounder[/b] - Daily, Spring and Summer, plus Fall 1 if it didn't rain on Summer 28
[*][b]Halibut[/b] - Daily, Spring, Summer and Winter, plus Fall 1 if it didn't rain on Summer 28
[*][b]Red Mullet[/b] - Daily, Summer and Winter, plus Fall 1 if it didn't rain on Summer 28
[*][b]Albacore[/b] - Daily, Fall and Winter
[*][b]Tuna[/b] - Daily, Summer and Winter, plus Fall 1 if it didn't rain on Summer 28
[*][b]Squid (1-10)[/b] - Winter 13 and 14
[*][b]Super Cucumber[/b] - Monday-Friday, Summer and Fall (excl. Summer 22) if it didn't rain the day before, plus Winter 1 if it didn't rain on Fall 28
[*][b]Octopus (0-1)[/b] - Daily, Summer
[*][b]Seaweed[/b] - Daily, all seasons
[*][b]Sea Jelly[/b] - Daily, all seasons
[/list]
[i]Notes/Exceptions:[/i]
[spoiler][i]Spends the evening at Trout Derby on Sunday Summer 21, skipping his usual evening session at the docks, so will not have Super Cucumber available on Monday Summer 22.
Will only be open for an hour on Winter 13 so you will have limited time to pick up a Squid that day.
Does not fish in the evenings when it rains, so will not have evening catches following those days.
Does not fish in the evenings in Winter, so will never have any Winter fish available on Spring 1.[/i][/spoiler]


[b][size=3]**River Stock**[/size][/b]
Willy spends dry Saturdays fishing in the forest and town rivers, and will sell his catch at the shop the next day.
During Trout Derby - Saturday Summer 20 and Sunday Summer 21 - he's at the river fishing all day regardless of weather, and his stock on Sunday 21 and Monday 22 will reflect this.

[list]
[*][b]Smallmouth Bass[/b] - Sundays, Spring and Fall
[*][b]Sunfish[/b] - Sundays, Spring and Summer, and after non-rainy Trout Derby days
[*][b]Perch[/b] - Sundays, Winter
[*][b]Chub[/b] - Sundays, all seasons, plus Monday Summer 22
[*][b]Bream[/b] - Sundays, all seasons, plus Monday Summer 22
[*][b]Rainbow Trout[/b] - Sundays, Summer, excluding days after Windy weather, plus 1-10 on both days after Trout Derby
[*][b]Shad[/b] - Summer 21 and 22, if it rained the day before
[*][b]Salmon[/b] - Sundays, Fall
[*][b]Pike[/b] - Sundays, Summer and Winter, plus Monday Summer 22
[*][b]Tiger Trout[/b] - Sundays, Fall and Winter
[*][b]Dorado[/b] - Sundays, Summer, plus Monday Summer 22
[*][b]Lingcod[/b] - Sundays, Winter
[*][b]Green Algae[/b] - Sundays, all seasons, plus Monday Summer 22
[*][b]River Jelly[/b] - Sundays, all seasons, plus Monday Summer 22
[/list]
[i]Notes/Exceptions:[/i]
[spoiler][i]Does not fish in the river on Saturdays when it rains, so no river catch will be available on the Sundays following wet weather.
Will only be open for an hour on Summer 21 so you will have limited time to pick up Trout Derby stock on that day.
He skips his river session on day 2 of SquidFest (Sat Winter 13) so will not have river fish available on Sun Winter 14.
Rainbow Trout spawns under any conditions during the Trout Derby days, so are guaranteed to be available on the days following, regardless of weather.[/i][/spoiler]

[i]

[/i][size=5][b]**BONUS STOCK LIST**[/b][/size]
You can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to enable the following extra options. These are turned off by default as they are not really part of his in-game fishing schedule. But with some creative interpretation, I think we could believe he would have this stock for sale...


[b][size=3]**Island Stock**[/size][/b]
Upon building the Island Resort, Willy starts ferrying people to and from Ginger Island. Let's pretend he does some fishing while at the Ginger Island docks!

[list]
[*][b]Flounder[/b] - Daily, Fall and Winter
[*][b]Lionfish[/b] - Daily, all seasons
[*][b]Tuna[/b] - Daily, Spring and Fall
[*][b]Pufferfish[/b] - Daily, all seasons
[*][b]Octopus (0-1)[/b] - Daily, Spring, Fall and Winter
[/list]
[i]Notes/Exceptions:[/i]
[spoiler][i]Nobody visits the Island if it's raining, so the shop will not have any Island stock on days after Island rain.[/i]
[i]If it rains in Pelican Town on Summer 28, Flounder and Tuna can still be available on Fall 1 if it was sunny at Ginger Island![/i]
[i]He will not sell Island Fish on the day after Green Rain in Year 1 (if you somehow have the Island Resort by then) regardless of the previous day's weather on Ginger Island.[/i]
[i]With this option enabled and the Island Resort built, and combined with his regular daily stock, you will now have Flounder, Tuna and Octopus available all year![/i][/spoiler]


[b][size=3]**Golden Tags - For Sale after Trout Derby**[/size][/b]
Perhaps Willy didn't use up all his Golden Tags, so puts some up for sale. As they can be stored after the event is over, maybe you'd like to put some aside for a head-start on next year's event! These will be available on Summer 21 and 22.

[i]Notes/Exceptions:[/i]
[spoiler][i]Like most of his other stock, he will sell 0-3 on each of these days, so might [/i]not[i] have any for you.
Shop is only open for an hour on the 21st, so you won't have much time to check![/i][/spoiler]


[b][size=3]**Desert Festival Stock - For Sale on Thursday Spring 18**[/size][/b]
We don't [i]see[/i] him fish at the Desert Festival pond, but let's pretend he does some fishing while we're not looking. As long as the desert has been unlocked, he will sell at least 1 of the following on the day after the Desert Festival concludes...

[list]
[*][b]Green Algae (1-10)[/b]
[*][b]River Jelly (1-3)[/b]
[*][b]Sandfish (1-10)[/b]
[*][b]Scorpion Carp (1-3)[/b]
[/list]


[size=5][b]**SHOP LORE STOCK - New in v1.1**[/b][/size]
These are turned off by default and will require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to turn on. They can be turned on/off individually. These are some extra items that it is easy for me to justify Willy selling...

[list]
[*][b]Shrimp[/b] - Have Willy sell some Shrimp every day. According to the flavour text on one of the containers in his shop, he has Shrimp on hand at all times.
[*][b]Crabs[/b] - Have Willy sell Crabs daily. It is clear at several points he is trying to raise his own crabs, after all. Choose whether he sells them all the time, or even before or after his 6-heart event, depending on how you interpret that event to influence his crab-selling past/future!
[*][b]Crab Pot Stock[/b] - Have Willy sell one freshwater and one saltwater Crab Pot item each day. Quantities will vary. Although we never see Willy do any crab potting around town, it is clear that he is an avid crab potter (sells them in his shop, all his mail recipes include crab pot fish, the incident with the crabs etc.).
[*][b]Cooked Meals[/b] - Have Willy sell more cooked meals throughout the year. There are 5 meals in total, and each one has a 50/50 chance of appearing after all their other conditions are met.
[*][b]Frog Egg[/b] - Have Willy sell the Frog Egg trinket. One of the other flavour texts in his shop is about a container of frog eggs.
[*][b]Lifesaver[/b] - Have Willy sell the Lifesaver wall art that can sometimes be fished out of the water in the back room of the shop.
[/list]
[i]Notes/Exceptions:[/i][spoiler][i]You can also choose to lock the Shrimp, Crabs and Crab Pot Stock (all chosen options) behind the Crab Pot crafting recipe requirement.
Shrimp and/or Crabs will be excluded from the saltwater Crab Pot stock if you have their individual options enabled.
The Cooked Meals are Crab Cakes, Baked Fish, Salmon Dinner, Fried Calamari and Fish Taco, and they are sold at similar times as the fish ingredients required to cook them, with Fish Taco being unavailable until Year 2 due to the Red Cabbage requirement. Crab Cakes availability will mimic your config choice for Crabs.
When choosing which Cooked Meals to include in the mod, I eliminated any that Willy didn't like/love, any having a recipe that he sends to the farmer by mail (those are family recipes he only shares with friends), and anything including fish that he couldn't catch in his normal fishing schedule.
You will be unable to equip the Frog Egg trinket until after you have attained Combat Mastery, but you can place it in an aquarium until then.
The Lifesaver wall art will see a big price drop after the back room is open.[/i][/spoiler]



[b][size=5]**COMPATIBILITY, INSTALLATION ETC.**[/size][/b]
[b]
Compatibility:[/b]
[list]
[*]Due to unique IDs, this mod is technically compatible with any other mod that adds fish to Willy's shop, but you may have fish appear multiple times in the shop inventory and at different prices. There are many mods that add fish to the Fish Shop. I recommend picking the mod that best suits your preferences and playstyle, rather than adding multiple mods that do similar things.
[*]There are no reasons I can think of that would make it incompatible with any other mod.
[/list]
[b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]Buttons Extra Trigger Action Stuff (BETAS)[/url]﻿﻿ is installed. This mod will not function without it.
[*]Make sure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ are installed.
[*]Add this mod's folder to your Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[*]Load up your game and configure the options with GMCM. This mod is safe to add/remove from your playthrough at any time.
[/list]
[b]Other Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]What about fishing treasure chests? Surely Willy fishes those up sometimes and would sell them in his shop? I agree, please check out my new mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42381]Willy's Treasure Chest[/url]﻿ - which was originally part of this mod but became so big it was split off into a mod of its own. They are companion mods to each other and for the complete experience I recommend using them both.
[*]I've included a config option to "Log Yesterday's Weather to Console". With this enabled, each morning a message will appear in the SMAPI console stating what yesterday's weather was. It will include yesterday's Ginger Island weather if you have unlocked the Island Resort. I added this during testing so I could verify the "yesterday's weather" checks were happening behind-the-scenes. I like it so I have left it in the finished mod. Leave this disabled if it doesn't interest you.
[*]Major festivals are not taken into account. The day after major festivals, stock inventory will be generated as though Willy was living his regular schedule the previous day (which he technically was, when the festival isn't active).
[*]I'm not far enough into my current playthrough, and cannot recall, if NPCs visit the Island Resort during passive festival days. If they don't, I will disable Island stock from appearing on days after passive festivals in a future update.
[*]Island Fish config does not account for the Island Resort being purposely closed by the player, so the mod will still add Island stock if the previous day was sunny but the resort was closed. I'm not yet sure if this is possible to fix, but if it ever is, I will account for that in a future update.
[/list]
